purpose: Teach: 趣向/営み/勤める/試聴/範疇/本位/比重/集英社

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ポスターに趣向を凝らされてますね
lines.en: The police really put thought into the design of those crime prevention posters.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, speaking directly to the listener. Even pace, genuine admiration without effusiveness. Slight nod in the voice on 'design.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域の営みを尊重した防犯活動、ありがたいです
lines.en: I'm grateful that the police conduct crime prevention work that respects the local community.
lines.style: Sincere, thoughtful. Pause before 'respects' — choosing the word carefully. Steady, earnest tone throughout. This is genuine praise, not performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域の駐在所に長く勤める警察官、頼もしいです
lines.en: The police officers who work at the local station for years — that's reassuring.
lines.style: Quiet confidence in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'years' to underscore the reliability of continuity. Warm and appreciative, with a touch of relief.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料の試聴会的な公開もされてますね
lines.en: The police also hold public listening sessions with investigation materials, don't they?
lines.style: Observational, appreciative tone. Gently curious — not questioning, but recognizing something noteworthy. Light, conversational rise at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本件は管轄範疇内でご対応ですね
lines.en: This case falls within your department's jurisdiction, so you're handling it, I see.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, respectful acknowledgment. Neutral-warm delivery. No doubt in the voice — just confirming what makes sense. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民本位の捜査姿勢、頼もしいです
lines.en: I find the police's citizen-focused approach to investigations reassuring.
lines.style: Sincere, direct appreciation. Slow enough to land the meaning. Warm without being deferential. A statement of genuine respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、暴力犯罪の比重を下げる活動を続けますね
lines.en: The police continue working to reduce violent crime — that matters.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not dramatic. Steady, measured pace. Acknowledges the ongoing effort with genuine recognition. Slight weight on 'continue.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、集英社の犯罪マンガに関する取材にもご対応ですね
lines.en: You've also cooperated with Shueisha on that crime manga interview, I understand.
lines.style: Acknowledging tone, slightly more familiar than previous lines. Lighter, a touch of wry recognition. Still respectful but with less formal distance. Genuine interest.
